what_to_detect: A resolution whose effect selects cards by their having an activated ability selects, outside the battlefield, a card whose activated ability can be activated only from another zone (reinforce, hand only): the ability still exists there and counts.
near_miss: Such a resolution passing over a card with no activated ability.
record_fields: payload.events zone_change of the selected cards
selected cards' sidecar lines (an activated keyword restricted to another zone)
